rationale: The agent executed an exchange write without an explicit confirmation from the user visible in the conversation, violating the confirm-before-write requirement. Authentication/ownership checks are unclear: while a lookup by name/ZIP and user details are shown, there’s no explicit validation that order #W4689314 belongs to the authenticated user. The replacement camera appears to change other specs (24MP to 30MP), contrary to the instruction to keep all other specifications the same, and there’s no demonstrated search to ensure the zoom is the maximum available. The agent also stated a precise price difference without tool-returned evidence shown. Although the agent used the requested PayPal method, these policy and fulfillment issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
